title: Roveia pinned hero (v2)
description: A window-tall rounded panel washed from white to sky blue: a centred 70px headline with a blue middle, then a row of a big stat, a 16:9 media slot and a short line with a blue pill, and a row of partner chips. On desktop the panel pins while the media grows to fill it under a darkening wash and the text turns white; on phones everything stacks and rises in.
notes: desktop (≥1024px): sized by the window (calc(100svh − 1rem)) inside a 210svh wrapper; CSS scroll-driven, no JavaScript
the header floats over it: put roveia-v2-header before it
the media slot takes a video or image (object-fit: cover); empty, it is a muted placeholder
